subject.title: security(audit): flag reachable plugin command chat surfaces

question: Should this audit check cover all chat-executable plugin commands, including default typed slash commands, or only provider-native command registration?
rationale: The proposed check and remediation describe general command reachability, but runtime executes plugin commands through typed text commands independently of native registration, so the permanent security boundary requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Audit all chat command ingress
options.body: Model typed and native execution plus effective sender authorization using actual runtime-slash command metadata.

options.title: Audit native registration only
options.body: Narrow the check ID, wording, documentation, and remediation to provider-native command registration rather than general command execution.

recommendation.title: Audit all chat command ingress
recommendation.body: Model typed and native execution plus effective sender authorization using actual runtime-slash command metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged history spans the audit collector, command routing, plugin command execution, and manifest alias contracts needed to resolve the boundary, alongside CODEOWNERS security review.
